# llms.txt

This is the Step It Up Strategies website.

## Website Purpose

Step It Up Strategies is a business management and consulting company specializing in restaurant, retail, and entertainment sectors. The company provides comprehensive business consulting services including operational strategy, financial management, menu engineering, and staff training.

## Site Structure

The site is built with TanStack Start, React, and Tailwind CSS. The landing page includes the following sections:

- **Hero**: Main value proposition and key statistics
- **Services**: 9 core service offerings, each linking to its own detail page (see Service Pages below)
- **Expertise**: Team credentials and qualifications (Certified Sommeliers, Spirit Experts, Food & Beverage Directors, General Managers, Owner Operators)
- **Financial Services**: Accounting and controller capabilities
- **About/Philosophy**: Company philosophy and sectors served
- **Notary Public strip**: Slim band beneath the credentials ticker linking to /notary
- **Contact**: Contact form for inquiries

## Service Pages

Each service category has a dedicated page covering capabilities, engagement process, deliverables, and FAQs:

- /services — overview of all nine categories
- /services/restaurant-consulting — Restaurant Consulting
- /services/retail-strategy — Retail Strategy
- /services/entertainment-venues — Entertainment Venues
- /services/menu-creation-food-cost-analysis — Menu Creation & Food Cost Analysis
- /services/beverage-programs-bar-design — Beverage Programs & Bar Layout Design
- /services/kitchen-layout-design — Kitchen Layout & Design Consulting
- /services/permitting-licensing — Permitting & Licensing
- /services/website-design — Website Design
- /services/business-accounting — Full Scale Business Accounting

## Notary Public

- /notary — Notary Public services. Certified, licensed and bonded notary public.
  In-office appointments at 504 W Plant St, Winter Garden, FL; mobile service
  throughout the greater Central Florida area; and remote online notarization for
  signers anywhere in the United States. By appointment only. The page carries its
  own appointment-request form (Netlify form name: `notary-appointment`).

## Technologies

- Framework: TanStack Start with React 19
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4
- Hosting: Netlify
- Language: TypeScript

## Sitemap

See `/sitemap.xml` for the complete site structure and page hierarchy.

## Form Submission

The site includes two forms that submit to Netlify Forms — the homepage contact form (`contact`) and the notary appointment-request form (`notary-appointment`). Form submissions are processed and forwarded to the business contact email.

## Accessibility

The site is built with semantic HTML, proper ARIA labels, and responsive design for all device sizes.
